method.languageReview: Compare exact informal Roman input with original native proposal. Research external spelling/component/name attestations; list limitations and assisted inference.
method.evidenceLimits: Usage is not a normative ruling or proof of intent. Some references were available only as search excerpts. Not all cases have sufficient external corroboration.
method.coordinatorContext: The coordinating assistant had prior context from Reviewer A’s first 21 draft decisions. Research assignments used the original case file without engine diagnostics or reviewer sheets. This does not count as an independent human review.
method.decisionMeaning: Accept, correct and exclude are assistant recommendations only; no canonical acceptance, corrected output or exclusion is admitted.

publicationScope.wordFields: Exact Roman input, original word proposal and draft suggested word readings, with source category and provenance.
publicationScope.sentenceFields: Case IDs, draft decisions, suggested output counts, confidence, reasons, alignment notes and citations. Complete Roman/native/suggested sentence strings omitted.
publicationScope.localRecordLookup: Regenerate the pinned development batch and select the matching case ID; verify caseFileSha256 before comparison.

wordExamples.author: AI4Bharat and the upstream sources identified by each category
wordExamples.terms: The official card distinguishes manually collected data (CC-BY) from mined IndicCorp/Samanantar and existing-source data (CC0). Preserve each record’s source category; these examples are not relicensed as MIT.
wordExamples.modifications: No word strings changed in this publication. Assistant suggested alternatives are separate draft annotations.

sentenceProvenance.author: AI4Bharat
sentenceProvenance.terms: The card labels collected data/packaging CC0-1.0 and notes AI4Bharat does not own underlying extracted text. Complete sentence texts are omitted from this publication.
sentenceProvenance.modifications: Sentence IDs and original review notes retained; complete input, source proposal and suggested output strings omitted.

attribution.consultedSources: Titles, URLs and narrow support notes identify third-party evidence. Their linked content retains its own terms; a citation does not certify a complete reading.

limitations: No independent human verification, normative dictionary certification or population accuracy claim.
Usage attestation does not prove a typist’s intended word or mandate deterministic key mappings.
Some evidence covers only components, names, other languages or search-indexed excerpts.
Confidence is an assistant judgment, not a calibrated probability.
Sentence proposals may change or omit words; quoted spelling evidence does not fact-check their claims.
This is the dated research pass, not a fresh engine diagnosis or an engine-fix list.
The later ra-ya implementation and maintainer source-quality triage are recorded separately in docs/package/ry-review.md.
Canonical review admission still follows the independent-review protocol.
